title: PUNCH NEEDLE for BEGINNERS - Embroidery and Rug Making Tutorial by Naztazia
description:
Learn how to do punch needle for beginners in this tutorial video. Hi I'm Donna Wolfe from Naztazia. In this video I show how to do the basics of punch needle embroidery and rug hooking. Punch needle is a vintage fiber art technique that creates straight stitches on one side of the cloth and loop stitches on the other. Monk's cloth or weavers cloth is used along with a punch needle tool and either yarn, thread, or embroidery floss. It's a wonderful art that works up fast and easy!

You can find more information on this pattern at: https://naztazia.com/punch-needle/
